_doc: Creature moves. type: physical (close, builds gauge), special (a skillshot that costs `cost` gauge segments; it travels and can miss), status (HOLD to channel up to `channel` seconds: the longer, the stronger its `effect` (effects.json); no moving or dodging, and a hit cancels it). kind picks the behaviour (MoveBook: strike, bolt, lunge, burst, guard, wall, status). windup/recovery: commitment (no dodging). stagger: stagger per point of damage. burns (Ember: grass to coals, vines burn), gale (flattens grass, clears fog), echo (reveals, shatters rocks), blooms (regrows burnt or flattened grass). desc: the sentence tooltips show (the numbers are added).

badger_bite.name: Bite
badger_bite.desc: A quick bite. Its basic attack (right click): builds gauge.

claw_rush.name: Claw Rush
claw_rush.desc: A wide claw swipe in front. Close range; builds gauge.

ember_pounce.name: Ember Pounce
ember_pounce.desc: Leaps to the cursor and bursts on landing. Builds gauge; roots trip it.

cinder_spit.name: Cinder Spit
cinder_spit.desc: A slow ember glob: lead your shot. Burns tall grass into coals.

growl.name: Growl
growl.desc: Hold to growl: the longer, the more the foe's power drops (up to -30%). You stand still; a hit cancels it.

cinder_roar.name: Cinder Roar
cinder_roar.desc: A roar of embers around it: hits, shoves, stuns, and sets grass alight.

fury_spin.name: Fury Spin
fury_spin.desc: Spins in place, hitting all around it 5 times. Builds gauge.

honey_rage.name: Honey Rage
honey_rage.desc: Signature move (level 25). A huge blast at the cursor after a clear warning.

glint_shot.name: Lash
glint_shot.desc: A quick tentacle lash. Its basic attack: builds gauge.

tentacle_snap.name: Tentacle Snap
tentacle_snap.desc: A long, narrow snap in front. Builds gauge.

prism_shot.name: Prism Shot
prism_shot.desc: A fast glass bolt. The quickest special to land.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.desc: Hold to blend in: foes lose track of you (longer when held longer). Attacking ends it, and the first hit you take is a critical.

shard_fan.name: Shard Fan
shard_fan.desc: A fan of 5 shards. Close range covers, far range leaks.

mirror_blink.name: Mirror Blink
mirror_blink.desc: Teleports to the cursor and flashes where it lands.

dazzle.name: Dazzle
dazzle.desc: A flash at the cursor after a warning: stuns everything there.

kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
kaleidoscope.desc: Signature move (level 25). A ring of 12 piercing shards.

pangolin_swipe.name: Swipe
pangolin_swipe.desc: A claw swipe. Its basic attack: builds gauge.

tail_swipe.name: Tail Swipe
tail_swipe.desc: A wide tail sweep that knocks foes back hard (into walls, off ledges).

roll_charge.name: Roll Charge
roll_charge.desc: Rolls to the cursor, hitting all on the way. Builds gauge.

harden.name: Harden
harden.desc: Hold to harden: takes up to half damage. Slow and unable to dodge while hardened.

vine_wall.name: Vine Wall
vine_wall.desc: Grows a wall of vines across the cursor: cover that blocks shots. Ember burns it.

seed_burst.name: Seed Burst
seed_burst.desc: Seeds burst at the cursor after a warning: damage, and heals itself.

bloom_wall.name: Bloom Wall
bloom_wall.desc: Signature move (level 25). A big ward that heals it and blasts foes around it.

wolf_nip.name: Nip
wolf_nip.desc: A quick nip. Its basic attack: builds gauge.

gust_bite.name: Gust Bite
gust_bite.desc: A biting gust in front that shoves foes back.

wind_dash.name: Wind Dash
wind_dash.desc: Dashes to the cursor, hitting all it passes. Builds gauge.

gale_shot.name: Gale Shot
gale_shot.desc: Three piercing gusts. They flatten grass and clear fog on the way.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.desc: Hold to wind up a sprint: much faster for a while, then lethargic (slow) afterwards.

howl.name: Howl
howl.desc: A howl that throws foes back, flattens grass and clears fog around it.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.desc: Signature move (level 25). A whirlwind around it that hits 6 times.

tap_shot.name: Tap
tap_shot.desc: A finger tap. Its basic attack: builds gauge.

echo_tap.name: Echo Tap
echo_tap.desc: Two echo bolts toward the cursor.

screech.name: Screech
screech.desc: Hold to screech: the foe takes more damage for a while (up to +30%). You stand still; a hit cancels it.

echo_pulse.name: Echo Pulse
echo_pulse.desc: A pulse around it: shoves, reveals hidden foes, and shatters cover rocks.

ghost_finger.name: Ghost Finger
ghost_finger.desc: Blinks to the cursor and taps the ground there. Builds gauge.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.desc: Signature move (level 25). Four pulses of sound at the cursor.

devil_crunch.name: Chomp
devil_crunch.desc: A chomp. Its basic attack: builds gauge.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.desc: A heavy bite in front. Builds gauge.

rot_spit.name: Rot Spit
rot_spit.desc: A slow, big glob of rot. Lead it.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: Lunges to the cursor and mauls what is there. Builds gauge.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: Hold to work up a rage: deals up to +50% damage, but takes as much more too.

stench.name: Stench
stench.desc: A cloud of stench around it that hurts 5 times.

rot_storm.name: Rot Storm
rot_storm.desc: Signature move (level 25). A huge rot blast at the cursor.

struggle_lunge.name: Struggle
struggle_lunge.desc: A weakened wild creature lashes out while it is being synced.
